title: Oct 25, 2026: Bots behind Tether's record day, Reflect's one-click stablecoins, Aave curated markets
summary: Crystal Intelligence finds 98% of a record day of Tether transfers came from bots; Reflect lets businesses issue branded stablecoins on Solana; Aave opens its first externally curated lending market. Plus the Bank of Israel on sanctions, South Korea's crypto tax delay, bitcoin below 80,000 dollars, and the X100 and Keystone incidents.

title: Oct 26, 2026: Canada's no-interest stablecoin rules, Anchorpoint's retail delay, Circle Match

Plus the GMO Internet extortion demand, Sony-backed Soneium's token plan, bitcoin back below 80,000 dollars before the Fed, and the Electrum fee-bump bug.
